Module io.github.jpersist.tools.api

module io.github.jpersist.tools.api
Defines the public API and Service Provider Interfaces (SPI) for JPersist persistence tools.

This module provides vendor-agnostic abstractions and contracts for build-time persistence validation, bytecode enhancement, schema verification, and named query parsing across JPA specification versions.

Exported Packages

  • persistence.tools – User-facing validation, query parsing, schema verification, and bytecode enhancement contracts.
  • persistence.tools.spi – Service Provider Interfaces (SPI) and factory discovery mechanisms for namespace-specific implementations.

Service Loader Discoveries

This module declares uses directives for the following service provider interfaces:

  • PersistenceServiceProvider
  • PersistenceLinterFactory
  • NamedObjectParserFactory
  • SchemaValidatorFactory
  • EnhancerProvider
